blockingFindings.title: Bound target mismatch no longer reports ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH
blockingFindings.issue: In `FlowManager.resolveActiveFlow`, the bound-flow branch now converts any explicit target mismatch into `FlowTargetNotFoundError` (`FLOW_TARGET_NOT_FOUND`). The task explicitly requires preserving bound `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` behavior. A command already bound to one flow but invoked with a conflicting explicit target should fail as a mismatch against that bound state, not as an absent target selection.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In the `flowState` branch of `resolveActiveFlow`, throw `ActiveFlowMismatchError` when `expectation.mismatchAgainst(flowState)` is present, and keep `FlowTargetNotFoundError`/`FlowTargetAmbiguousError` for unbound active-flow selection only.
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 is a mandatory acceptance criterion and specifically names bound `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` behavior. Returning `FLOW_TARGET_NOT_FOUND` changes the durable error contract for bound target conflicts, so this is blocking.

blockingFindings.title: Required dispatcher and target-resolution coverage is missing
blockingFindings.issue: The touched tests update `worktree-flow-command-identity.test.js`, `resolve-active-flow.test.js`, `plan-rewind.test.js`, and `set-step.test.js`, but R9 requires spec-local and shared target/dispatcher tests covering exact, ambiguity, mismatch, preparing, bound, and no-log cases. The requested extensions to shared dispatcher/no-log coverage are not present in the touched file set.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Add or extend the required spec-local and shared tests, especially dispatcher target-failure-before-runtime-log/no-log assertions and bound mismatch assertions, with `// spec: R9` headers as requested by the task.
blockingFindings.rationale: R9 is a mandatory acceptance criterion. The implementation changes dispatcher target failure behavior but does not include the required dispatcher/no-log and full target matrix coverage, leaving the guardrail unverified.
